title: Classify all ten minimum-grade cooperative repairs of P104 receiver 127
body:
On the #7786 rational word, every cooperative repair of the frozen receiver-127 cut spends at least seven total grades. Exactly **ten** positive-transfer topologies attain seven. They all run from chart 278 through 288 to 127, with one optional intermediate chart on each side. The original two-send route is uniquely cheapest at the enrolled exponent. Across 48 calls, the runner-up costs an additional **0.257824154185…** signed units. Every topology outside the ten adds more than **47.224621260611…** units.

This answers the cooperative-routing question left by #7807. The lower bound allows arbitrary deterministic encodings, all-time access to frozen local stock, and any finite number of nested-span messages between the original charts. Four public inputs force the route through both endpoints and the intermediate chart. The upper bound constructs all ten chronological words and checks all 1,289 terminal operators. Changing the surviving paid observations, chart atlas or productive ledger remains a separate question. This cut gives zero improvement to the selected bound.

Clear1nsight supplied the #7786 word and the #7795 stock obstruction. #7807 supplied the direct-send result and the four separating inputs.

All six registered CPython 3.12 checks passed in the checkout and from the read-only, Git-free export of the submitted commit. The repository checks also verified committed bytes, source history, file modes and the export inventory.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-receiver-relay
```

Prepared by apoursh with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
